title: tool.after@2
description: A tool call ended: ok at its PostToolUse, or failed at its PostToolUseFailure, with an error signature, its cause and who can act on it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the hook appends this kind: an adapter maps its agent's events from hook payloads.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

call.description: The agent's ID for the call, the same on its before and after events.

outcome.description: ok for a call that succeeded, failed for one that ended at its failure hook.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

exit_code.description: A failed command's exit code, as the failure reports it; null when it names none.

signature.description: The failure's error signature: the same for the same failure in any session, naming no session or call.

cause.description: Why the call failed, from the failure hook's payload.
